desc:
Hold the zone. First to 100 wins.

WARGRID: Contact is a King of the Hill shooter. Two sides fight over one big zone: every 15 seconds the side with more troops inside scores a point. A glowing hot zone moves around inside it — stand there and you count double and earn double. No timer, the first side to 100 points wins.

• Call vehicles with V: jeeps, Badger IFV, Warden tank, Aegis anti-air, transport and attack helicopters
• Deploy at the front from your team's Spawn Truck
• Dig in: trenches, sandbags, walls, bunkers, watchtowers
• Four classes: Assault, Engineer, Marksman, Specialist with launchers and MANPADS
• Five maps: Black Quarter, The Twin Locks, Greywood Station, The Spindle, Graylin
• Upgrade every gun from Mk I to Mk IV, pick sights and skins
• Battle pass, daily rewards, leaderboards
• Bots fill empty slots, so every battle starts full

RULES: No exploits or cheats (flying, teleporting, speed hacks). Cheaters are kicked and banned. Banned by mistake? Contact us.
